en.description:
CrownSpin is a European roulette wheel for Apple Watch and iPhone.

On Apple Watch, turn the Digital Crown to spin the wheel. Flick it fast and the ball starts to run. Feel each pocket pass with a light haptic click, then watch the ball drop into its pocket.

On iPhone, swipe the wheel or tap Spin. The same 3D wheel and the same physics run on both devices.

STATISTICS
The new Statistics tab on iPhone shows your spin history:
- Total spins and your current color streak
- Red, black, and green counts and percentages
- Odd and even, low (1-18) and high (19-36)
- Hot and cold numbers
- Longest red and black streaks
- Your last 20 results
- Hits for every number from 0 to 36

Filter the statistics by iPhone, Watch, or all spins. Spins from your Apple Watch go to your iPhone automatically when the two devices connect.

FEATURES
- European wheel with 37 pockets (0-36)
- Realistic 3D wheel and ball
- Haptic feedback that you can mute
- The Watch app works without the iPhone app

CrownSpin is for entertainment only. There is no betting, no real money, and no prizes.
en.releaseNotes:
- New iPhone app: swipe the wheel or tap Spin.
- New Statistics tab with colors, odd and even, low and high, hot and cold numbers, streaks, and the last 20 results.
- Spins from Apple Watch appear in the iPhone statistics.
en.subtitle: Quick Casino Wheel Simulator
